settings.body: RYVT is an athletic wear label out of Metro Detroit, built for people who train hard and then keep the same clothes on for the rest of the day.

We are a small team — pattern cutters, athletes, a couple of stubborn perfectionists — making a short, deliberate range instead of a long, forgettable one. Every piece earns its place or it does not ship.
Founded in Detroit, RYVT exists to prove that performance kit does not have to shout. Clean lines, fabric that behaves, fit that holds its shape after fifty washes.

Our mission is simple: fewer, better pieces — cut properly, priced honestly, made to be worn until they wear out. We design in the city, test in the city, and we do not release anything we would not train in ourselves.
